title: Perception
text:
This contains only the notes that was mentioned that should be studied. However the levels of automated driving is also added.  Also just to be sure some types of sensors. 


Classification: - Determine class of the object within its general category
Detection: - Find the location of objects from a general category in sensor data
Ranging: - Estimate distance of a detected object
Recognition: - Find exactly the same object instance in sensor data
Tracking: - Estimate (and predict) path of a detected object - Recognition over time





precision is the percentage of correct detections. \[
Prec = \frac{TP}{TP+FP}
\]



Recall is the percentage of how many of the postives it could find out of the dataset \[
Rec= \frac{TP}{TP + FN}
\]



The F1-score is a trade off between precision and recall \[
F_1 = \frac{2}{\frac{1}{Rec}+\frac{1}{Prec}}= \frac{2*Rec*Prec}{Rec+Prec} = \frac{2|TP|}{2|TP|+|FP|+|FN|}
\]
